resources.string: Adaptive Free AI is ready through the cloud. It learns which route is faster and more reliable without running a model on your phone.
Connect OpenRouter Free once to enable lightweight cloud AI.
Waiting for an internet connection. No local AI model is running on the device.
Free AI needs an internet connection. No local model is loaded, so the phone stays light and cool.
Connect OpenRouter Free in Settings > AI providers, then try again.
The OpenRouter Free connection is no longer valid. Reconnect OpenRouter Free in Settings > AI providers.
